mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, expires_at FROM nc_session WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nc_session (id, account_id, expires_at, last_seen_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{expiresAt}, #{at}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE nc_session SET last_seen_at = #{at}, expires_at = GREATEST(expires_at, #{expiresAt}) WHERE id = #{id} AND expires_at > #{at} AND last_seen_at <= #{at}
